title: ALPR Surveillance Oversight
text: Automated license plate readers installed along neighborhood arterial roads require strict retention limits and public audit logs to protect resident privacy.

title: Predictive Policing Audit
text: Algorithmic crime forecasting software risks reinforcing historical arrest disparities in lower-income census tracts without independent civil rights auditing.

title: Municipal Facial Recognition Ban
text: City agencies should prohibit biometric facial recognition cameras in public parks and municipal buildings until binding privacy safeguards are enacted.

title: Flock Camera Contract Transparency
text: Before renewing private surveillance camera contracts, the council must disclose third-party data sharing agreements with external law enforcement networks.

title: AI Procurement Accountability
text: Every municipal software vendor deploying automated risk scoring or citizen triage models should publish an algorithmic impact assessment.

title: Smart Streetlight Sensor Privacy
text: Acoustic and optical sensors mounted on smart streetlights should be disabled from recording audio or tracking pedestrian identities across intersections.

title: Data Broker Opt-Out Ordinance
text: Local residents deserve transparency when municipal utility portals or parking apps share geolocation telemetry with commercial data brokers.

title: Police Drone Flight Logs
text: Unmanned aerial surveillance drones used for emergency response must publish anonymized flight paths and warrant justifications each quarter.

title: Automated Benefits Eligibility Review
text: Algorithmic fraud detection tools in social service applications must guarantee human appeal rights before any household benefits are suspended.

title: Civic Digital Twin Privacy
text: City planning digital twins built from mobile location pings should use differential privacy aggregation so individual commuters cannot be re-identified.

title: School EdTech Surveillance Limits
text: Public school districts should restrict automated proctoring webcams and student sentiment monitoring software that collect behavioral biometrics.

title: Biometric Access Controls
text: Replacing keycards with fingerprint or iris scanners at municipal recreation centers introduces unnecessary biometric breach risks for families.

title: Inclusionary Housing Mandate
text: New multifamily residential developments over twenty units should set aside at least fifteen percent of apartments as deed-restricted affordable housing.

title: ADU Permitting Fee Waiver
text: Waiving impact fees and standardizing pre-approved architectural blueprints for accessory dwelling units will accelerate backyard rental construction.

title: Downtown Mixed-Use Rezoning
text: Converting underutilized single-story strip malls along the boulevard into four-story mixed-use apartments will revitalize local commerce and expand housing supply.

title: Workforce Homebuyer Assistance
text: Down-payment assistance grants targeted at local teachers, nurses, and firefighters are essential to keep public employees living in the community.

title: Tenant Eviction Protection
text: Establishing a local just-cause eviction ordinance and mediation clinic helps low-income renters avoid displacement during sudden rent hikes.

title: Parking Minimum Reform
text: Eliminating mandatory off-street parking minimums near major transit stations reduces construction costs per apartment and encourages walkable neighborhoods.

title: Missing Middle Duplex Zoning
text: Allowing gentle density such as duplexes, triplexes, and courtyard cottages in single-family residential zones creates attainable starter homes.

title: Senior Affordable Rental Trust
text: Dedicating municipal housing trust funds toward ADA-accessible senior apartments enables older residents to age in place near medical clinics.

title: Short-Term Rental Regulation
text: Capping whole-home vacation rentals preserves long-term residential rental stock for local workers and stabilizes neighborhood housing costs.

title: Community Land Trust Expansion
text: Partnering with nonprofit community land trusts keeps subsidized townhouses permanently affordable across successive generations of homebuyers.

title: Streamlined Multifamily Review
text: Ministerial by-right approval for code-compliant infill apartments eliminates years of discretionary delay and lowers financing costs for builders.

title: Rental Registry and Habitability
text: Creating a transparent rental inspection registry protects tenants from chronic mold, plumbing neglect, and unaddressed heating failures.

title: Oak Woodland Corridor Preservation
text: Protecting continuous coastal oak woodland corridors from hillside grading safeguards native wildlife migration and reduces wildfire ember spread.

title: Urban Heat Island Canopy Plan
text: Planting drought-tolerant native shade trees across asphalt schoolyards and shopping center parking lots lowers peak summer surface temperatures.

title: Watershed Stormwater Runoff
text: Bioswales and permeable pavement along commercial corridors filter heavy metal runoff before stormwater drains into local creeks and wetlands.

title: Data Center Water Moratorium
text: Proposed hyperscale computing facilities must disclose closed-loop cooling plans and guarantee zero depletion of municipal drought aquifers.

title: Municipal Composting Hubs
text: Neighborhood organics drop-off stations at weekend farmers markets divert food scraps from landfills and cut methane greenhouse gas emissions.

title: Pollinator Meadow Restoration
text: Eliminating neonicotinoid pesticides in public parks and seeding native milkweed corridors supports declining monarch butterfly and bee populations.

title: Solar Microgrid Resilience
text: Installing rooftop solar arrays and battery storage at community libraries creates clean-energy cooling centers during grid blackouts and heatwaves.

title: Native Turf Replacement Rebates
text: Expanding lawn-removal rebates for native sage and California buckwheat gardens sharply decreases residential outdoor water consumption.

title: Dark-Sky Wildlife Lighting
text: Retrofitting commercial floodlights with warm shielded LED fixtures reduces nocturnal glare and protects migratory bird navigation paths.

title: Riparian Creek Bank Bioengineering
text: Restoring willow vegetation along eroded creek channels stabilizes floodplains naturally without pouring concrete culverts.

title: Building Electrification Incentives
text: Rebates for residential heat pumps and induction stoves help households transition away from aging natural gas appliances.

title: Open Space Wildfire Fuel Breaks
text: Targeted ecological grazing and invasive mustard removal along the wildland-urban interface lower catastrophic brushfire risks.

title: Protected Boulevard Bike Lanes
text: Concrete-curb protected bicycle lanes along the main commercial boulevard keep commuter cyclists and middle-school riders safe from fast traffic.

title: Express Commuter Bus Frequency
text: Running fifteen-minute peak express buses connecting suburban park-and-ride hubs to regional rail stations alleviates daily freeway congestion.

title: Pedestrian Crosswalk Beacons
text: Installing leading pedestrian intervals, curb extensions, and flashing rectangular beacons near elementary schools prevents intersection collisions.

title: Arterial Pothole Resurfacing
text: Prioritizing full-depth asphalt repaving on heavily traveled commuter roads prevents axle damage and improves emergency vehicle speeds.

title: Traffic Signal Synchronization
text: Coordinating adaptive traffic signals along cross-town corridors reduces stop-and-go idling and smooths rush-hour commuter travel times.

title: Seismic Bridge Retrofitting
text: Reinforcing aging concrete highway overpasses and creek bridges ensures freight and transit lifelines withstand major regional earthquakes.

title: Evening Transit Shift Coverage
text: Extending local bus operations past 10 PM enables restaurant, retail, and hospital shift workers to commute reliably without a car.

title: Sidewalk Accessibility Ramp Audit
text: Repairing tree-lifted concrete sidewalks and installing ADA tactile curb ramps allows wheelchair users and strollers to navigate safely.

title: Storm Drain Culvert Upgrades
text: Widening bottlenecked underground storm culverts under main avenues prevents street flooding during atmospheric river rainstorms.

title: Safe Routes to School Slow Zones
text: Lowering speed limits to twenty miles per hour with raised speed tables around campus pickup zones calms cut-through neighborhood traffic.

title: Regional Rail Last-Mile Shuttles
text: Micro-transit electric shuttles timed with commuter train arrivals bridge the first-and-last-mile gap between rail platforms and office parks.

title: Pavement Striping Visibility
text: Refreshing faded lane markings and reflective road studs along hilly curves improves nighttime driving safety during coastal fog.

title: Annual Parakeet Show Notice
text: The tri-county aviculture club is hosting a weekend parakeet ribbon competition and birdseed swap at the fairgrounds pavilion.

title: Vintage Typewriter Repair Club
text: Collectors of mechanical Olivetti and Royal manual typewriters meet every third Thursday to exchange ink ribbons and platen rollers.

title: Integrated Eco-Transit Smart Village
text: A net-zero transit-oriented affordable housing village combining solar microgrids, bus rapid transit, and privacy-preserving energy meters spans every city department.
